description: This file implements a Python class `LangchainProcessor` that integrates Langchain runnables into the Pipecat framework. It handles processing LLM message frames, invoking Langchain chains asynchronously, and streaming responses back as text frames with response markers.

classes.name: LangchainProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that connects Langchain runnables to Pipecat's frame pipeline, enabling language model processing with streaming responses.

methods.name: __init__(self, chain: Runnable, transcript_key: str = "input")
methods.description: Initializes the LangchainProcessor with a specified Runnable chain and optional transcript key.

methods.name: set_participant_id(self, participant_id: str)
methods.description: Sets the participant ID for session tracking purposes.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, extracting messages if applicable, and invoking the Langchain chain for response streaming.

methods.name: str __get_token_value(text: Union[str, AIMessageChunk])
methods.description: Extracts string content from different message object types.

methods.name: _ainvoke(self, text: str)
methods.description: Invokes the Langchain chain asynchronously with the given text, handling streaming of tokens back as text frames.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
